note: Neighbouring skills that share an agent's catalogue with the skill under test. Names follow the NVIDIA/skills catalogue and common agent skills; descriptions are short paraphrased stand-ins written for trigger evaluation, not the official text.

skills.name: tao-generate-image-grounding
skills.description: Open-vocabulary object grounding on an image: given an image and a caption of what to find, return phrases, pixel bounding boxes and scores. Use when the user wants boxes around specific object types.

skills.name: vss-ask-video
skills.description: Answer ad-hoc visual questions about a recorded video clip, such as what happened at a given timestamp. Not for long-video summaries.

skills.name: vss-summarize-video
skills.description: Summarize a long recorded video into a timeline of notable events. Use for 'summarize this footage' requests.

skills.name: local-pedestrian-detector
skills.description: Detect pedestrians in a street or campus photo and return person boxes with neutral appearance descriptions. Never infers identity, age, nationality or intent.

skills.name: accelerated-computing-cudf
skills.description: GPU-accelerated dataframe analysis with cuDF for CSV/Parquet data: aggregations, joins, time series, and charts.

skills.name: cuopt-routing-api-python
skills.description: Solve vehicle routing and delivery scheduling problems with NVIDIA cuOpt from Python.

skills.name: rag-blueprint
skills.description: Deploy, configure, troubleshoot or shut down the NVIDIA RAG Blueprint for enterprise document question answering.

skills.name: marketing-copywriter
skills.description: Write marketing copy, social media posts, slogans and promotional poster text for products.

skills.name: inventory-replenishment
skills.description: Generate replenishment orders from inventory database records and sales velocity. Works on data only, not on photos.

skills.name: retail-shelf-audit
skills.description: Inspect a retail shelf photo and return front-row SKU facings per shelf, empty gaps, image quality, and uncertainties as structured JSON.
